description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/weno5_eno1_D1y_extrapolate_bc. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NX=NY=8 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the per-axis hybrid WENO5/ENO1 upwind y-derivative D(u, wrt: y) (priority 10) replaced by the rule's body (the per-axis frame around the interior stencil, seven regions: hybrid interior block [3,6]x[4,5], ENO1 strips [1,2]x[4,5], [7,8]x[4,5], [1,8]x[2,3], [1,8]x[6,7], and the two ghost wall lines j=1, j=8) carrying the free names dx, dy, wind_u, wind_v, bdy_eno1_cells, weno_band_cells, with zero unlowered rewrite-target ops in the equations, zero surviving metaparameter names. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise (or by sha256 digest when >= 64 KiB) by the other bindings. The golden is the reference-preserving lowered form (esm-spec 9.6.4): match-less template references in the rule body (the frames, the interior and point stencils) survive as resolved apply_expression_template leaves and the imported template registry is part of the golden, so the golden pins the whole composition, not only the equations.
